classification.difficultyReason: Apply exact trigonometric ratios to unknown sides in differently oriented right-angled triangles, including unknown denominators.

content.prompt: Find the exact value of $x$ in each diagram. No calculators required.

spec.description: An unshaded right isosceles triangle with horizontal bottom and vertical right legs, matching double ticks, a right-angle marker, hypotenuse 6, right leg x and bottom-left angle 45°.
spec.mathematics: The two legs are equal; x is opposite 45° and the hypotenuse is 6.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear in the question diagram.

spec.description: An unshaded right isosceles triangle with horizontal top and vertical right legs, matching double ticks, right angle at the upper-right vertex, vertical leg 3 and hypotenuse x. An external 45° label has a curved arrow directed into the lower-right interior angle.

spec.description: An unshaded right triangle with horizontal top leg, vertical right leg 7, hypotenuse x, right-angle marker at the upper-right vertex and 60° at the lower-right vertex.
